newsitem.title: USA: Lott would like U.S. tax cuts of over $150 bln.
newsitem.headline: Lott would like U.S. tax cuts of over $150 bln.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Wednesday he would like to see tax cuts of more than $150 billion.

Lott was asked about a statement he made earlier in the morning that the Republican legislative priorities for the coming year included a multi-year tax cut package worth $100 billion to $150 billion.
"I would like it to be more than that," Lott, a Republican from Mississippi, told reporters at the start of a joint House-Senate leadership meeting.
"We are not committed to a number now at all, obviously, we want to see what the president has to say," Lott said.
Asked whether the range of tax cuts he had mentioned earlier was a middle ground, Lott said it was "probably the low ground."
